risks.title: Dependence on agricultural profitability
risks.score_rationale: Demand for irrigation systems is driven by the profitability of agricultural production, which primarily depends on crop prices and agricultural input costs. Fluctuations in these factors directly impact farmers' purchasing decisions.

risks.title: Competition in irrigation systems
risks.score_rationale: The market includes several manufacturers offering alternative irrigation systems (flood, drip, other mechanical systems). Center pivot systems must demonstrate economic superiority compared to these alternatives.

risks.title: Dependence on water availability
risks.score_rationale: Demand for irrigation is influenced by water availability, food security concerns, and countries' desire to achieve food self-sufficiency.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks from international operations
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in multiple countries (Brazil, France, China, Turkey, South Africa, Netherlands, Egypt, Australia, New Zealand) with production and distribution facilities, exposing operations to geopolitical risks.

risks.title: Technological dependence
risks.score_rationale: Products incorporate advanced technologies (GPS, IoT, machine learning, cloud computing, remote sensing) requiring ongoing R&D and technological integration capabilities.

ai_positioning.summary: Lindsay Corporation integrates machine learning into its FieldNET Advisor technology, which uses machine learning to provide crop-specific and field-specific irrigation recommendations. The company combines scientific expertise accumulated since 1955 with cloud computing capabilities, remote sensing, and machine learning to help farmers make precise irrigation decisions.
evidence: FieldNET Advisor combines crop and irrigation science with machine learning to provide farmers with field-specific and crop-specific irrigation recommendations
Technology uses cloud computing capabilities, remote sensing functionality and machine learning
